arguments.prompt:
Create one standalone logo proposal screen for the personal brand “Jovina Diniz”.

This screen must contain ONLY one logo concept for review.

**LOGO DIRECTION:** Abstract architectural symbol.
Create a refined abstract symbol using architectural ideas such as passage, opening, shelter, threshold or path to communicate self-return, identity and direction. It must feel premium and original, never literal. Pair the symbol with the name “Jovina Diniz” and the descriptor “Terapeuta Integrativa & Mentora de Mulheres”.

**PRESENTATION:** Show the symbol + wordmark as the primary lockup and one simplified icon version. Label the screen “Opção 05”.

No cliché therapy or wellness imagery; exclude lotus, butterfly, brain, heart, hands, female silhouette, tree, moon, mandala, leaf, infinity symbol, medical cross.
